WITH pathology_events AS ( SELECT clinical_event_id, patient_id, start_date FROM clinical_event PREWHERE patient_id = #{patientInternalId} WHERE upperUTF8(event_type) = 'PATHOLOGY SLIDES' ), timepoint_events AS ( SELECT event.patient_id AS patient_id, toNullable(event.start_date) AS procedure_date_days, nullIf(maxIf(data.value, upperUTF8(data.key) = 'SAMPLE_ID'), '') AS sample_id, nullIf(maxIf(data.value, upperUTF8(data.key) = 'SUBTYPE'), '') AS subtype, nullIf(maxIf(data.value, upperUTF8(data.key) = 'MATCH_LEVEL'), '') AS match_level, nullIf(maxIf(data.value, upperUTF8(data.key) = 'IMAGE_IDS'), '') AS image_ids, coalesce( nullIf(maxIf(data.value, upperUTF8(data.key) = 'SPECIMEN_KEY'), ''), nullIf( decodeURLComponent( extractURLParameter( maxIf(data.value, upperUTF8(data.key) = 'LINKOUT'), 'specimenKey' ) ), '' ) ) AS specimen_key, nullIf(maxIf(data.value, upperUTF8(data.key) = 'TIMEPOINT_SOURCE'), '') AS timepoint_source FROM pathology_events event INNER JOIN ( SELECT clinical_event_id, key, value FROM clinical_event_data WHERE clinical_event_id IN ( SELECT clinical_event_id FROM pathology_events ) ) data ON data.clinical_event_id = event.clinical_event_id GROUP BY event.clinical_event_id, event.patient_id, event.start_date ), timepoint_exact AS ( SELECT timepoint_events.*, arrayJoin( JSONExtract(assumeNotNull(timepoint_events.image_ids), 'Array(String)') ) AS image_id FROM timepoint_events WHERE timepoint_events.image_ids IS NOT NULL ), timepoint_legacy AS ( SELECT * FROM timepoint_events WHERE timepoint_events.image_ids IS NULL ) SELECT toString(ref_sample.stable_id) AS reference_sample_id, toString(portal_sample.stable_id) AS sample_id, part.part_key AS part_key, part.part_number AS part_number, part.part_designator AS part_designator, part.part_type AS part_type, part.part_description AS part_description, part.subspecialty AS subspecialty, part.path_dx_title AS path_dx_title, block.block_key AS block_key, block.block_number AS block_number, block.block_label AS block_label, slide.image_id AS image_id, slide.stain_name AS stain_name, slide.stain_group AS stain_group, slide.is_hne AS is_hne, slide.is_ihc AS is_ihc, slide.magnification AS magnification, slide.file_size_bytes AS file_size_bytes, slide.can_serve_tiles AS can_serve_tiles, slide.barcode AS barcode, slide.slide_type AS slide_type, placement.match_level AS match_level, placement.specimen_key AS specimen_key, if( coalesce(timing.timing_present, 0) = 0, coalesce(timepoint_exact.procedure_date_days, timepoint_legacy.procedure_date_days), timing.timeline_start_days ) AS procedure_date_days, if( coalesce(timing.timing_present, 0) = 0, coalesce(timepoint_exact.timepoint_source, timepoint_legacy.timepoint_source), timing.timepoint_source ) AS timepoint_source, if( coalesce(timing.timing_present, 0) = 0, if( coalesce(timepoint_exact.procedure_date_days, timepoint_legacy.procedure_date_days) IS NULL, 'UNDATED', 'RECORDED' ), coalesce(timing.timeline_date_kind, 'UNDATED') ) AS date_kind, if( coalesce(timing.timing_present, 0) = 0, coalesce(timepoint_exact.timepoint_source, timepoint_legacy.timepoint_source), timing.timeline_date_source ) AS date_source, if(coalesce(timing.timing_present, 0) = 0, NULL, timing.timeline_date_reason) AS date_reason, if( coalesce(timing.timing_present, 0) = 0, if( coalesce(timepoint_exact.procedure_date_days, timepoint_legacy.procedure_date_days) IS NULL, 'MISSING_PROCEDURE_DATE', 'AVAILABLE' ), coalesce(timing.timeline_date_status, 'MISSING_PROCEDURE_DATE') ) AS date_status, if(coalesce(timing.timing_present, 0) = 0, NULL, timing.timeline_coordinate_system) AS coordinate_system FROM ( SELECT * FROM wsi_patient PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) ps LEFT JOIN sample ref_sample ON ref_sample.internal_id = ps.reference_sample_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM wsi_part PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) part ON part.cancer_study_id = ps.cancer_study_id AND part.patient_id = ps.patient_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM wsi_block PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) block ON block.cancer_study_id = part.cancer_study_id AND block.patient_id = part.patient_id AND block.part_key = part.part_key LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM wsi_slide_placement PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) placement ON placement.cancer_study_id = block.cancer_study_id AND placement.patient_id = block.patient_id AND placement.part_key = block.part_key AND placement.block_key = block.block_key LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM wsi_slide PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) slide ON slide.cancer_study_id = placement.cancer_study_id AND slide.patient_id = placement.patient_id AND slide.image_id = placement.image_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT *, 1 AS timing_present FROM wsi_slide_timing PREWHERE cancer_study_id = #{studyInternalId} AND patient_id = #{patientInternalId} ) timing ON timing.cancer_study_id = placement.cancer_study_id AND timing.patient_id = placement.patient_id AND timing.image_id = placement.image_id LEFT JOIN sample portal_sample ON portal_sample.internal_id = placement.sample_id ANY LEFT JOIN timepoint_exact ON timepoint_exact.patient_id = placement.patient_id AND upperUTF8(timepoint_exact.match_level) = placement.match_level AND timepoint_exact.specimen_key = placement.specimen_key AND timepoint_exact.image_id = slide.image_id AND upperUTF8(timepoint_exact.sample_id) = upperUTF8( if(placement.sample_id IS NULL, 'Unmatched', toString(portal_sample.stable_id)) )
AND replaceAll(upperUTF8(timepoint_exact.subtype), '&', '') = multiIf( slide.is_ihc, 'IHC', slide.is_hne, 'HE', 'OTHER' ) ANY LEFT JOIN timepoint_legacy ON timepoint_legacy.patient_id = placement.patient_id AND upperUTF8(timepoint_legacy.match_level) = placement.match_level AND timepoint_legacy.specimen_key = placement.specimen_key AND upperUTF8(timepoint_legacy.sample_id) = upperUTF8( if(placement.sample_id IS NULL, 'Unmatched', toString(portal_sample.stable_id)) ) AND replaceAll(upperUTF8(timepoint_legacy.subtype), '&', '') = multiIf( slide.is_ihc, 'IHC', slide.is_hne, 'HE', 'OTHER' ) ORDER BY sample_id, part.part_key, block.block_key, slide.image_id
